import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import lib5; from lib5 import *
d=np.load('carry_prov.npz')
H0=np.load('pass_23/token_hidden_L0.npy').astype(np.float64); msk=np.load('pass_23/attention_mask.npy').astype(bool)
M0=(H0*msk[...,None]).sum(1)/msk.sum(1)[:,None]
Zp=np.load('pass_25/token_hidden_L1.npy').astype(np.float64)
Zc=LN(Zp[:,0])  # CLS
exp_c=d['s']*(M0-d['mu0'])@d['wraw']
r=Zc[:,RES]
print('corr per dim', [round(np.corrcoef(r[:,j],exp_c[:,j])[0,1],3) for j in range(8)])
# per-sample proportionality
ratio=(r*exp_c).sum(1)/(exp_c**2).sum(1); print('ratio mean/cv', ratio.mean(), ratio.std()/ratio.mean())
print('resid rel', np.linalg.norm(r-ratio[:,None]*exp_c)/np.linalg.norm(r))
print('RES mag CLS', np.abs(r).mean(), 'KEEP mag', np.abs(Zc[:,KEEP]).mean())
rng=np.random.RandomState(0); tr=np.ones(64,bool); tr[rng.choice(64,16,replace=False)]=False
for drift in [0.0,1.0]:
    for lam in [30,100,300]:
        keep,Wf,b,info,X=fit_layer(0,25,1024,W,base,lam=lam,drift=drift,tr=tr)
